name: Stars Arena share-buy reentrancy
summary: The share-buy entry point (selector 0xe9ccf3a3) sent AVAX back to the caller before finalising share accounting, letting the attacker re-enter the weight-setting function (selector 0x5632b2e4) mid-call so that a single share could then be sold via sellShares() for ~266,000 AVAX.
notes: The second and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected the vulnerable Stars Arena implementation.
The exploit trace records exactly 266,103.97278 AVAX transferred from the Stars Arena proxy through the attack contracts and then to the attacker EOA.
